description: Pre-selected tile bounding boxes and time periods for Lab 11 (change detection). Each entry is a small AOI over the Denver area with an expected change character, so exercises produce interpretable results. Feed these bboxes and dates to geo-foundation-models change_detect (or embed_tile + difference).

tiles.label: denver_metro_seasonal
tiles.expected_change: vegetation green-up (deciduous leaf-out, agriculture, snow melt)

tiles.label: den_airport_development
tiles.expected_change: urban development / new construction near DEN
tiles.note: Exercise 2 — set threshold 0.4 to catch structural change only.

tiles.label: downtown_stable
tiles.note: Exercise 3 control area — expect lowest change.

tiles.label: eastern_suburbs_growth
tiles.note: Exercise 3 — expect highest change of the three areas.

tiles.label: forest_west_baseline
tiles.note: Exercise 5 — baseline + monitor; flag if similarity drops below 0.85.
